name: Pencil Spaces
description: Pencil Spaces is an innovative platform designed to enhance online collaboration and productivity. It offers a virtual workspace where teams can seamlessly interact, share ideas, and work together in real-time, making it ideal for remote work and education environments.

events.d: Creates a new collaborative space and invites the listed hosts and participants.

events.n: User Joins or Leaves a Room
events.d: Runs when a user joins or leaves a room in Pencil Spaces.
